posts.linkedin:
Static ads with long captions are often ignored before anyone reads the offer.

I see three problems: large image files slow down the feed, the ad has no motion to attract attention, and the design looks like dozens of other ads.

A short animated video can show the main offer within the first few seconds, keeping the viewer before they scroll away.

Try using a simple motion video for your next campaign instead of a long static caption.

You only pay after you approve the final ad.
